subject: Re: Follow-up after discovery — tight slots for technical deep-dive
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up after discovery — tight slots for technical deep-dive

Alexis — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap: you and the Finex infra team are focused on predictable latency at scale, SSO/KMS integration, and a tight rollout window for a POC in Q4. I captured the notes in the attached discovery_notes.pdf.

Next step: technical deep-dive with SE + infra (20–30m). Your team indicated calendar pressure this week, so offering three compact slots (all PT):
- Tue 10/05 — 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed 10/06 — 14:00–14:30 PT
- Thu 10/07 — 09:30–10:00 PT

Can you pick one and reply with a one-line confirmation (we'll send a calendar invite)? If you don't confirm by EOD Monday we'll release the slots and propose new times next week.

Also looping in Ben (SE) to prep the runbook items we should cover. If you'd prefer a 20m focused session (just latency + routing policies), say so and we'll compress the agenda.

Thanks — Connor
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: discovery_notes.pdf (summary of call + prep questions)

Connor — apologies, I had an unexpected ops incident and missed the earlier slot. Appreciate the summary and the notes.

The team would prefer a shorter session (20m) focused on latency SLOs and KMS patterns. From my side these two slots look possible (ET):
- Wed 10/06 — 17:00–17:20 ET (14:00–14:20 PT)
- Thu 10/07 — 12:30–12:50 ET (09:30–09:50 PT)

If either works, I can confirm immediately. Procurement looped in for timeline questions — they asked if we can get the pricing one-pager ahead of the deep-dive.

— Alexis

Head of Platform Engineering, FinexCorp
alexis.turner@finexcorp.com

Alexis — thanks for the quick reply. Wed 10/06 14:00–14:20 PT works for us. I've scheduled the compact deep-dive and attached the calendar invite (cal-invite.ics). Agenda (20m):
- 0–5m: concise goal alignment and success criteria
- 5–13m: latency architecture + routing fallback (Ben)
- 13–20m: targeted Q&A and next steps (procurement to confirm timelines)

Please reply with a one-line confirmation ("Confirmed") so I can lock the invite. If we don't get a confirmation by EOD Monday 10/05 we'll open this slot and propose new options.

Procurement — looping you for any pre-read requests; attached pricing one-pager for reference.

See you Wed — Connor
